name: forge
description: Forge: one productivity-first plugin that merges spec-kit (Spec-Driven Development), ECC (agents, skills, rules, hooks), agency-agents (specialist personas and NEXUS playbooks), Matt Pocock's skills (grilling, TDD, tickets) and Addy Osmani's agent-skills (spec → plan → build → test → review → ship).

hooks_enabled.title: Enable Forge hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run the Forge lifecycle hooks (session context, destructive-command guard, post-edit format/typecheck, compact suggestions, pre-compact snapshot). Set FORGE_HOOKS=off to disable at runtime.
